payload.title: Gate-14D 实验：RTI-SQP 实时性（RTI-RE vs RTI-SP, N=8/5, 1/2 iter）

payload.method: RTI-SQP 1-iter: warm start -> nominal rollout -> autograd Jacobian linearization -> LTV-QP (L-BFGS-B, box) -> apply first step.
payload.RTI_RE: re-run full PatchTST encoder each stage (A-only r2 model).
payload.RTI_SP: rollout-trained scheduled propagation (latent propagated, context rescheduled; A_openloop model); no PatchTST per stage.
payload.findings: RTI-SP 1.6x faster than RTI-RE; N=5 brings RTI-SP to Strong GO (78ms); 2 iterations do not improve RMSE and double runtime.
